comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你让伙计蹲到台脚。他原以为又要被抓作挡刀的人，抬头才看见你已转去接另一侧。同伴没因你先拉一个人，便让第四次换手的璧失了踪。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 华丽匣子被丢到另一条路。你们把真玉裹低，肩上终于只是常见的行囊；当晚仍有追兵看破，不再是人人隔半条街都能认。

firstDivergence.text: 前面左侧能绕。我没把全部告诉你，这一段是真的。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

firstDivergence.text: 你们按约见人，先交一份订钱，余款等做成再结。老人听到皇家二字先皱眉，等看见玉，反倒愣住，指着那块银补问怎么成了这样。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你们早来的一程赶上老人试料。沈守着灯，江帮着转了半夜磨盘；等试片裂开才知这半夜还不算开工。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你们多走一程，才把真物送到旧匠手里。他不先夸难得，只把玉转到窗下，看西角银补和背后火熏，叹怎么成这样。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 为核旧识晚来的一程，错过老人这炉试料。你们另付一夜柴钱等下一炉，订钱也在这时交下；核过手艺没有替你们省掉等工期的日子。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 老匠按你们挑定的样子把断续处连齐，仍留真物上认得出的曲折，图一眼看全。真物旧刀痕和银补不照搬，假货反倒更像竞价人嘴里的皇家重宝。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 那条金线完整便最真的夸法也流下去，仿者把每条线描得更齐。沈后来听见，只把旧试片翻到粗糙的一面，没有再去替自己那一块报唯一。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 玉色更匀，边完整，没有真物那块丑银补。金线也补全，只是放消息时先让人看清玉质与整边。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 玉色纯、边完整的价钱仍往上涨，仿者把银补彻底从传闻中删掉。沈后来听见，摸过试片没磨平的一角，没有拿它换回一个鉴真人的名号。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你不去见接头人。箱子交我，后面的路我们自己走。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 学徒后来南去学艺，换过师，也有没做好的活。那支追兵没有因为自己与沈江见过一面，就知道该去找他要哪个人的命。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 他们若回来问，你从后门走，到渡头等。钱和去处先留给你，不说跑完便一定没事。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 学徒腿养了一个月才继续南去，另走的路费与代下的活也有人接。沈托去的那份确实到了，不用他的伤替自己留一个终身该追问的人。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 两人坐下吃一顿热的，没有再问这一口算欠谁。江嫌菜太咸，沈把水推过去，自己也喝了一碗。你们没有在这一顿谈谁会先死。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 钱从剩下的路费里补。你们少坐一夜热屋，至少做假那几个月的活不再只剩一句以后有空再报。江说这门大买卖，怎么算都该先不赚。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 最后一辆车转出，人也散到低处。你们把原来能混在人群里走的一步放掉，刀便从两侧清楚逼来。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 先前放走的最后一辆车已转到低处。赶车人从那里把散包扔回山口，喊声引开外侧追兵片刻；沈沿石后的窄缝拖着木箱退，没能把江也拖出。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 赶车人听见你喊，先带学徒那一班撤。你们留在窄口，木箱压在脚后，不再等别人替你们的假来历站住。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 赶车人记得你们喊过的石角，带慢的人下去后又从低处喊了一声。他抛起散包，引开外侧追兵片刻；沈沿石后的窄缝拖着木箱退，木箱过去了，江没再应她。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 沈不拿短刃硬格刀身，肩贴近一步才挑到腕侧。刀口偏了，震回来的力却压得她手指发麻。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 江把剑尖留在对方前腕前，不与长刀比沉。对方退的半步刚够沈收进来，江的右肩却被第二人的短兵顶住。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 布一下便湿透。沈把另一只手也压上去，江看了她一会儿，不再催她先看箱。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 沈把江扶到石后，药沾在指上，手却仍要压住血。两个人挪出的这一点阴影，挡得住目光，挡不住已经留下的伤。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 沈托可信的普通行路人带一份钱与口信，不带自己的新住处。她能交还的只交还这一份，不用一句亏欠要求谁替她永远守秘密。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 在仍属于她的日子里，沈接过一只洗好的药筛，等新收的衣裳晒干。有人来问那位药材商遗孀，她只说这里缺一个肯做活的人。旧钱与试片仍在盒中，明日的饼不必再靠抢一块玉才买得来。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 沈把路费、药费和未清的食宿钱一笔笔另记，不写取璧的密令作凭。哪里能托人交清，便托人；写下的纸不再交给等她杀人领功的人。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 沈把最后一笔能托到的旧账交清，收起私记。旧铜钱没有拿去抵这一笔，试片也没有写成给谁的保证。她仍记得有人买饼时先抱怨一句打呼；往后的纸，终于可以先写她自己还要过的日子。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 她找的是清洗药筛、抄一张普通药单的活。能做的先做，不能做的请人教，没有把内廷旧识变成新招牌。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 养过那次伤，沈去洗药筛，头两日手酸得抬不起。药铺只按做完的活结钱，她隔日再去，才攒到下一包药；没有因识旧物便有人肯预付一月工钱。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 她付清一笔最急的药钱，剩下的分到欠过饭的人手里。对方问以后去哪，她只道有处住，不再报一个能被追到的姓名。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 当钱先清急药与欠饭，药铺那一笔没有赊下。等伤渐好，饭铺肯再留两日饭，她先去帮着择菜偿这两日，才腾得出一夜另记旧账。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 她留一张家常账纸。旧路上真正肯做过的事，有些能记，有些仍不愿给外人一句解释。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 她把笔搁下，没将最后一句续成替两人都选定的答案。纸背还能用，先记了明日要付的药钱。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 它来了多久？同桌子一起？

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你先问它压了多久，才出价买它。这份来历，倒比外面那些齐全的还真。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 卖么？我先问价，不白拿你的压缸石。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你蘸墨写下两行，何老板拿远又拿近，终于点头。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 当年我只叫字写好点，你就给我看了两行。后来真交来，纸角还卷着，你倒先怕我把它压在菜底。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我听过成亲，不知道姑娘名字，不能先替她写一个。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 当年你先问姑娘名字，没来问猫。我媳妇后来还说，这先生至少没把别家的名字抄给我们。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 同物换名数次，短名那本用途已空。堂兄把你先前弃在一旁的旧册取回，半夜灯只剩一截。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 九库总验的旧称先帮你找到了这页；堂兄叫你把前后两个书名都留着，免得递上去又按山河璧三个字找不回来。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 修补信给了一个真物的痕，不给全部用途。堂兄把旧物清册找来，让你逐条对，不拿像那个角便说每条传闻都真。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 银补信把你引到旧物清册，真到璧半册半这一页，仍得另抄旧称。修补痕能认物，没替你省下这一夜补称名的工。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 图与册各一半。没对明白的地方，我跟着答，不让抬箱的人替我说已经全懂。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 玉与残档两封都到了，封上来路还在。内官叫你等另一名核件者腾手，你在廊下站到腿麻，才听见两份都收妥。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我带这一份，你留哪册找出的页码。问不到我时，也还能找到不是我写的旧字。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 堂兄留的原查簿没到京，你把核过的副件一页页指给收件者。少一处原页码便须回信再问，今夜先把还不能答的那处留空。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 旧档放在内官手边，还没递到司马面前。你看着玉上没尽的盐痕，越等越想是不是漏洗了一角。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 晚辈不懂剑，只觉得几条河路不像画给人看山水的。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你想起当年自己先指图不对的地方。这一回你没有抢答，等他自己把残片推回匣里。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 何家压咸菜缸十三年。晚辈洗了三日。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 压过缸的。动手时我记着这句——这玉没享过福，刮它不冤。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 盐渍在这一侧。它从何记铺里取出，压过缸，不是另受了哪种武火。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你说它压过缸、有盐渍。工匠后人下手时轻了些，像在给一件干过活的东西对账。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 请准三日，先把还在的这一层描下，再按命剥。纸料我想法子，过三日不再请拖。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 先前花三日、垫纸料留下的表层描本还在。第四、五库你亲进去，木架与坏药的那几处写得很慢；留给接手者的，也有真能再去核的地方。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 先看暗刻。我随首批去，遇上旧注对不出的，回来补，不拦着等画全。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你先开暗刻，赶过首批，又回档房补两夜，错过第四、五库现场。后来两页仍留同队见者姓名，不会因为你已做官，便把那一段旧闻改成自己当年亲入。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 一处旧河早改，册中要按验点重认。带路人把你指的水线推回半寸，问你真走过没有，你说没有，明日一起走。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你先对过旧河改道，头三处才没算白走。骂图的人少一句，你心里那句自己没验过的，也少一句。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 灾务官让人加了验粮的小筛，军中要看弓材与弦，不要描金的宝函。你发现真问到该怎样用，自己原来准备的纸反倒少了一摞。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 头三处你带的是空筐与验器。挖开的却是塌方与酒窖——筐没用上，你倒庆幸没抬金匣来丢人。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 塌、酒窖、黑泥，就按这三处报。还能找的在后面，不在我一句这回一定有。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 前三处空库照实报的那份，灾务这边都传看过。没人再等你翻本，只等车。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 路没假，库却真坏了。请他一起答，我不能替他把什么时候渗水说全。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 带路人同你一起具名那段，底下人记得。报实情的官，问路才有人肯答。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 县中管仓的带你量了通风口，讲药为什么会坏。你抄到一半，又把先前只写空的那格改了，不敢说自己这一夜便能教他管几十年仓。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 第五库记过的通风口尺寸还在纸角，灾务官拿去同这几箱车具的防潮盖对。你得留下补一幅小图，少睡的一段没因已经过五库就还回来。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你挪空筐，验药人拦下想把霉药拿回去的人，说这不是捡漏的时辰。你腾出门侧，让他们一包包真验，不先拿好心把坏东西再发一回。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 第五库替验药人腾路时用坏的空筐得补。你同车夫在第六库多找一圈，才找出还能修的一只，不把帮忙过就算器物没有耗。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你接了一份今晚的转报，走完再睡。灾务官把验粮小筛带上，没叫你先承诺明日一进门就能翻身。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你随粮务这一路走到第七库。灾务官那句别先承诺明日翻身，你记着进门。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你把六处各由谁亲入、自己哪些能答写清，报给值房。下一班赶上，第七库的石门还埋在旧河边深土里，你手里不再只有那一张让人来恭喜的买玉故事。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你赶在第七库开门前到班。六处实况已先送全，进门的不是一句盼着翻本的运气。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你把锅交给已到的伙计，自己蹲到端空碗的母女旁。母亲阿荞说父亲手麻，走得慢，先在上游木亭等；孩子怕你以为他不来便不算一口。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 雨要落，你先帮锅边人一碗碗送。阿荞问能否给父亲带一份，你答能，让她先拿热的走；他在哪里、谁还同等，要请下一班再问。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你站回锅边，一班真做完才离。阿荞后来带着空碗来，不先谢宝，问有没有一段绳把包扎牢。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 接班人走到锅边应了，你才跟队去第八库。阿荞回来找的是那个能答车次的人，没有因为你不在就只剩一张写过字的木牌。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你先看了船工怎样等潮。几年后到蓬莱，也先看岛上的人怎样过日子，才问他们的剑。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 箱子不好下手，船工让你换到低的一头。你照做，脚下的船板随着第二个人上来，往下一沉。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你把图叠小，油布边角压进包内。船人叫到第二声，你才发现他喊的是这班船，不是你的名字。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 船停。人，也先停。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 五年前那一下午对过的箱单，后来转船一直这样分。病时阿汀照单把物件和路钱交到店里，自己照开船。你少请一趟脚夫；醒来时，箱单折在药碗旁，末一只已由店家画了点。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你把这一扣亲自系好才回身。阿汀已经在另一侧撑住船，弟子见你不答，手又推到近处。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 按五年前说的，物件与路钱一直由你点收。如今站不起来，临时请店家接；阿汀得开本船，另请脚夫搬物、候一宿的费用从你行资里出。他仍帮你找好住处，把脚夫的姓名也留在箱单上。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 岸边腾出一步，对方师父还是从正面进。你接住后看见他肘侧有一线，换到那里时，他已追不上你下一步。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你们移开船缆，他没有因此少用力。来拳从肩外逼入，你把近处一线放开，回手落到他第二步难接的位置。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 先让我看你们怎么走这一步。旧卷可以晚一点再抄。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你在阁里练过这一步。再试，别照我的身子落脚。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 旧卷能指去处，不能让今天的主人先认你。你一处处敲门，遇见已改过的练法，又回来问为什么。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 前人的脚到了。你自己的，还差这里。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 这里。我以为还能转回来。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 当年在蓬莱，你为免剑脱手往后退半掌。如今空着的手收回来，那半掌已在身侧；旧对手贴进来，你没再往脚后找。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 没剑以后，你肩仍先堵住自己的转身。大长老看你重走，脚下又截去半步。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 当年在蓬莱，你丢开剑重走一遍，才看清肩先挡了转身。如今对方又压这一侧，你肩头未动，脚已在他能跟来的地方落稳。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我还想去。看看比这更高的。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 赢完呢——这一问你没能接上。海上一个多月，你没有答出；四十岁离岛，它仍跟着你，只是从逼问变成一张真买下的船票。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我想再赢。还有什么，现在说不出。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 从这一句想起的问法你留着。后来每赢一场，都先往下多问一层；到真上船那日，你说得出的仍只有一句，却已经是你自己的。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 先别问武馆。我现在走过去，怕要叫人以为是来讨一张床。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 早早认了站不住，床与汤都近。后来你向学生讲第一步，也先讲这个：先认自己此刻在哪里，才谈往哪里去。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你交完话，刚站一下便又坐回去。阿汀叫人抬你，自己先去接船务，这两件终于不用都挤在你一只发软的手里。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 船务没因你病停一日。十二日里你躺着仍把账目逐笔对了——认输的病与该交的话，你从那时起就分得清。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你写得工整，店家照字又念一遍，没笑你的口音。门里汉文谱从小读，真到街上，原来连一个药包也得两个人肯听完。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 阿罗真三个字你到底写在了前头。后来榜录写罗天海，你从不让旧名从纸上消失——两个名字，一个是你来的地方，一个是你走出来的地方。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 罗天海。阿罗真也是我，别把旧名那份药另算一个人。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 罗天海在前，阿罗真也在。中原的榜自此只记新名，你自己记账，仍旧一页两名。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你没追笑声，眼睛一直在他的肩与脚。第一下比地方榜快，第二下却给你看清了一处转路；等他换回来，你已经跟到那一边。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你把距离放开又贴回，对手没有被一个新口音的人气得抢招。你得一次次换，到真能从他身侧续出的那一手才敢压过去。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你去了，吃过败，也遇过打完肯讲两句的人。走回住处时，脚下反而比来前快，怕明日又错过能见一个人的时辰。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你多留几日，把那一下不肯完全懂的来路又试了。再走出去，旧对手没有因为你已赢过南榜便自动成了只配被略过的一页。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 第二次我以为已经改了，其实只多换一门。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 两次败里同一处没接住，你当面摆过，没有拿第三次那场平盖过去。武当停手时你想起这件事——老人不问你的平，问的还是你输的样子。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你原想重走上回的位置，他却换了进路。你跟着退半步，第三次的平也没能替第四次先备好答案。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 老对手也在变——这一课你带上了武当。百余招你自己先停，因为你看见他的脚，正往你原来想逼去的位置外多走半寸。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你上山时还以为，只要他够强，自己便能再学一门。过门第一眼却看见老人搬石头，一块一块，放到他要的地方。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 上山那日你直接请问手，也问自己的路。老人不收，五日不改口——你后来才懂，他把这两问当一问：答不出第二句，第一句便不算数。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 老人正在搬石头。你看了半日，没看出一套暗藏的拳；石头确实从这边搬到了那边，院里空出一块能走的地。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你先看了半日他搬石头。第五日他反过来问你要什么时，你答得出他每日做什么——这半日，比二十几场胜更先让他抬头。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 因为你强，所以我想学。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我从前以为学得够多，就总能再换一条。现在说不出哪一条是我。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你原本会让人多站半个时辰。第一个学徒说，站完还得去扛料；你看他回去举木，才知道自己说的松肩，在他的日子里到底卡在哪里。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 旧馆那次代课接不下去，没被你藏在新匾后面。你把出门请客的时辰分一半给普通同练，亲手教两人怎样看第三个人，不能每次都说等宗主回来。木工终于能带一班，自己也少接了几日整活。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你把一次练习停在两人之间，没替较慢的那人迈完。他们先互说哪里难，再请你看。收工迟的学生只能另约一班，课得分成两次，能跟上的人却开始自己接着练。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 旧馆两人接得住的课，在新门还接着。可分班时的缺口也一同带来，你给晚班留了固定时辰，不因新客来问就总挪。卖鱼人愿意代看早班，却说清赶集日不能来，你得另找肯接的人。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我出去也会输。回来，你们照旧问，别见我带一场赢就把不会的都吞回去。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你逐个看过才留，没写一本能叫人照着熬满半年的大谱。十二个人的难处不同，回来的时候也得逐个接。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你顺着那只仍会变的手向侧边走，他肩一转，你也不留在上一刻的路里。又二十余招，掌从侧面递出，停在他后颈之前。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你没有凭一句放空就忽然多出力气。来招仍真，脚下仍得接。二十余招后，手从身侧续上，终于停在他已不及转身的后颈。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 木工先走，卖鱼人没照着他的脚去站。你轮流接，手里试出的距离不同，后退的位置也不同。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 开门先让两人各走各的一步——门规头一条便是这么来的。学我者，不得终于我，写的不是客气，是那天你轮流接手时量出的两段不同距离。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 不能来同一班的人，也要有地方问。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 哪一种教法还跟不上，第一日就有人当众答了。门规写在改完的课表后头，所以它一挂上去，就有人能照着走。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 因为我还没死。等我死一百年，它还站着，再谈。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我还活着，哪里就算到头了。等我死一百年，你再看它还站不站着。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 先找我徒弟。找完觉得我教得不对，再来问我。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你留下的院门没有把人关在你的那一步。后来有人问祖师最会什么，学生先走出自己的拳，再说：他肯看我们重来。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你少去一班自己还想看的课，坐到来信人与年轻弟子之间，讲怎样转船、怎样问一个陌生人真正肯说的话。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 地图被后来人的手添出一处新港。那里不必叫罗天海，也不必有你的塑像；有人肯继续走，便有人会把回信送到下一岸。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你们说起从前接错的一步，谁也不替谁少记。说累了便停，院外人听见的笑比招名多。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 第二日，旧友陪你在门边看课。年轻人接得有不稳的地方，也有你没先教的转法。旧友才抬手，你便按住他，等那两人走完。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 疑处也写进去。我走过的，你能问我；我没见过的，不替我说见过。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 残卷前留着那张成卷年月未填的旁注。后来借卷的人问过那一格，门里仍答不知道；抄本就连空格和转交来路一同抄去。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 注明据说。再把你们新走的那几条也放来，别叫这一叠把后面的都压住。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 残卷与新路记同架。有人寻最新的一条航路，先抽走了后添的纸；要问祖师的旧路，还得回来翻那几十页上写着据说的来历。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 手心沾了一点湿木屑。你站起时没比船快，反倒真看清黑崖上那两个字。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 学生把栏抓得指节发白，像十二岁那回的你。你把自己的手放在旁边，让他先握着，又等他肯松开一指，才把船再晃一下。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 老人把你身旁的空桶推远一点，自己仍扶着舷。船身回落，你才把脚移到刚才放桶的地方。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 学生坐在船边等浪过去，你也同他坐一会。十二岁时那位老人挪开空桶等过你；这回你先把学生脚边的杂物挪开。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你落后一截，转身时却还能换气。阿岑在前面呛了一口，听你呼气，终于也慢下来。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你比阿岑绕得远，却没被回流带回去。他到岸时咳着问为什么，你指向刚才反复转白的水。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 他扯半晌解不开，索性拿膝顶住绳圈。你笑他，又看他真急了，只得凑过去同他拆开；轮到他绑，倒也卡住了你的指头。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 早年你肯同阿岑互解一扣，这几年忙起来，却也常由最快的人一把做完。教头这回的问，把那项已经会过却没一直做的事又放回眼前。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你练到手指发热，自己解扣越来越快。阿岑拿来却还打不开，木刀那边已经叫人，你答应明早再同他换。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 十二岁那回，你第二日真去叫过阿岑，一扣也教过了。十七岁再回头看，换了新人，还是得让他从头试，不能指着自己和阿岑都会，就算这班人都能接。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 阿岑真把绳递回来，你才发现他留的扣与你习惯不同。两人拆到指头发酸，回去时饭已经温了。他抢走碗底那块鱼，说早来就有热的，偏要留这会儿。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 早年一起换手练的习惯，他又教给后来人。有人解得比他慢，他等那一下，没因自己一直做得到便替旁人的手一把全做完。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你一人练到绳股磨热，收放确实更快。别人来接时，你仍惯于自己抢回来做完。那句以后问没有消失，只是被每天最急的活挤到后头。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 旧腕阴天仍会酸，他不再拿伤替别人换一声勇敢。新人来接，他把那一扣教到对方真能解，再把绳松过去；你少赶那一班夜课，同他等到最后一轮试完。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你又跌一次，手还没摸到舷，船已往另一边沉。老师挪开脚，给你留了爬回来的地方；你刚上来，膝盖便又得跟着松。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你试着松膝随船转，压住的地方却没有跟来。十八岁时能换出的那一步，此刻先得有人替你移开木梁。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 一退，船头又翘起来，你只得把刚找的地方也放掉。第二步落下时，老师才点头。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你想像当年在小船上那样退半步，脚跟却卡在梁下。你只得停住，把胸口勉强留得出的那口气用来喊人。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你守这根，不随我跳。过来一个，先送进去，别堵船头！

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你还想答已说过了，叶孤舟让你把下次谁留岸上再报一遍，直到名字也说清。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 先接这几个人。我去远头，别叫他们跟我挤在一边！

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你报了阿岑，话到一半，又想起他还在往里送人。你得再找一个肯留下的，不能只把同一个名字报两次。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 梁压住我。你别来，留在能接人的那边！

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你手抬不起，只能用眼与下颌示向那边。阿岑看明白，朝后来的人转喊；你喊到最后没了声，也没能凭想救人便忽然推开木梁。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 腿仍抖，你就蹲着接递来的手。你没有成为最后离船的人，只把眼前能送到舱内的这一位真送过去。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 蹲着接递来的那只手——你后来对每个新人都讲这一下：接应不是站到最前，是让路一直有下一只手。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你扶一个人往里退，近处的人才跟着让路。风里那道能落脚的空处，比你再喊一遍我能跳更有用。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 把船头的人往里送、留出落脚处——那一晚你学会的接应，是先让开一步，不是再喊一声我能跳。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我看见要去的人，却没再看脚下会断的地方。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 我看见要去的人，却没再看脚下会断的地方——这话说给叶孤舟时你没遮。半年后他肯把你调进内院，先看的就是这句不遮。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你在岸上走到那一步，脚便停住。没有风，仍能看见自己当时只盯着要到的地方。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你把落脚到被压那一段重走过。所以半年后叶孤舟问还跳不跳，你答得出：跳，但不会那样跳了。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 叶观澜师兄第四，您第六，放中原算第几？

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 若换成平地，那三步还能这样走？

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 观澜又进，你放掉预想里那阵浪，才在真实石面上找到还能退转的一点。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 平地上放掉预想那阵浪，才找到还能退转的一点。后来你教人认潮，头一句也是：先把脚下这块真实的石面看清楚。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 同一来掌，两人续法不同。你刚想说看明白了，孤舟便把你叫回原处，让你亲接；你挡住前半手，后半步已经叫他转到肩外。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 同一来招两人续法不同——你亲站进去接过后才懂。此后再听人报座次，你先问自己在哪一块地上站过。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 第一招叶进，谢侧一步。那一步不是退远，却叫叶原可接上的一处挤在两人身后；你眼睛跟过去，才发现棍还得从别处回来。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 第一招叶进，谢侧一步。叶步没乱，棍也快，你几乎想替他说这一步走得对；可眼前两人的位置已经和你那句对不一样。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 您是不是状态不好？

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 当年问叶孤舟是不是状态不好，话一出口，自己都觉得该有别的解释。如今胸口那一指还在，你先把想问老人是不是趁你没备好的话压住。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你每一手都知道自己在做什么，为什么还会那样？

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 当年问他每手既知道为何还输，如今这一指，也没给你多出一手的工夫。你把方才准备进的那一步在心里重走，仍没问出晒鱼老人的确切境界。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 这会多占出港前半刻。有人嫌慢，你让他真从另一头接，自己也从那一头走回；直到不靠你喊第二遍也能松开这条路。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 那我回家了。明早头一班，我照旧来。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你做得快，其他人也习惯等你做完。你以为最险的归自己就是负责，至于自己被另一处叫走以后谁接，常留到真起风才再说。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 他们得知道下次有人接，才敢先进去抬人。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你把账页带到船工面前，先报今日各人该收的，再问有没有漏记。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你把绳又递回船工手里，请他从接过这一头，走到能把人送进去的地方。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 周后来去一趟，两边七年没再动。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 他后来把什么留在那里了？

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你交过来的差，我接。但下回你说谁接哪一头，我会听完。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你到白沙屿，没让两边再摆一场拳。今日争的是谁先用修船地，你得听他们把能过明日的办法说完。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你少跑几条自己仍想去的远线，先把早课与晚归的人分开接。周替你接远港，你替他带回来的新人多留一课，谁也没凭一张排班就同时在两地。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你把船晃起来，让后来人自己迈下一步。没有人永远站稳，课却可以一直有人接。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你少亲看几班刚学会的弟子，把课交给同门，再带新人上船。周问你谁接下一港，你回去真找本人说清，不把岸上的人当一声托付就永远有空。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 下一港还没入眼，接班的人已经在船头。你不替他报一个海的尽头，只把能问下一句的地方指给他。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 东崖后的路不设擂台，也没有一行固定椅子等你对号。你走到院口，先闻见晒鱼的咸味。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 名次放在门外，你先闻见晒鱼的咸味。此后每次进生地方，你都先找有活气的地方站。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 先看。别认得一张旧总谱就替每个人把今天安排好了。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 带着能听见答复的问题进去——竹匾那一声轻响替你把长串问题删短了。此后你进门先听，再问。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我刚才脚还没走。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你才动，便想起刚才肩上那点先紧。老人没抬头替你判对错，只叫你往旁边半步，别挡太阳。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 不知道。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 不知道——你说得响了些。后来整理口述的人记下这句时，也记下了你当时让开门边的样子。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 第三是现今总谱写的。是不是全门最强，我不知道。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 第三是能核的名次，最强不能替没出手的人答——后来人把这句也带去问了下一座岛。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 前几下仍高。你把脚也挪一点，竹竿才从肩下真正送出去。老人看你又数，没有催你快点叫他一声师父。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你教他数。不数，怎么知道有没有变好——这句话你十三岁说过，如今原样递下去。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你慢下来，竹竿尖反比刚才晃。老人用两指在你肩前一点，你才察觉自己每次要证明能刺得远，先把这里顶了出去。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你叫他先问肩为什么抬。当年老人两指一点的地方，如今轮到你站在旁边看。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我会了。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你没再说会。十四岁那三招替你把这两个字收了一辈子。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我来接这三样，您别先给我留手。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 没等他问，你先请他试。六合馆的老规矩：熟和会差哪儿，枪比嘴清楚。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你把灯留给阿原，他还得补自己没走完的拦。早起时，纸没有因昨夜早睡便自己多动，你仍从第一下开始。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 到第七下，肩已先提。你把枪放回，师父从门里看见，没叫你为一个勤字再撑到下一百。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 他左脚慢一点，回枪便接不上。你重走给他看，又让他自己来，才知道半日改出的路，也得逐个人走。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你写得细，师父叫你拿枪在旁等。阿原照着走仍卡住，你只得再站进去；纸没有因写全便替人把腰转过来。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 为什么停？

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你先撤那一步，与当年对周师收枪是同一样东西：不把没分完的胜负抢先说成自己的。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 这里进得去，后面还要真接。今天不是非分不可。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你先撤那一步，收在方才真看见的那条线上——二十二岁学会的，先说清自己看见什么，再谈谁赢。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 前面还有，我不知道该问谁。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 周师说等着，等着便有人。你在檐下劈柴，忽然信了这句——前面的人，未必长成你想的样子。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你照旧来看他教年轻人，听他骂拦枪时手腕先歪。三个月后，他在散课时递来一封信：楚怀锋。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 前路仍不知道该问谁。你先把今晚的柴劈完，明日照常练枪。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你错过原拟同行的车，另走一段路。阿原第一晚还等你接话，第五晚终于自己叫人站进去。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 这一页我来讲，后面你若另走了，不必叫他们以为我也全会。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 这回我先走。那班缺的工，回信说给我，不能全算你们应该接。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 后来班开起来了。我只是不想让他们以为，你一封信，别人的日子就自己接上。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你走到最后一枪，才发现肩前已满，没有能收的那半寸。楚怀锋站在你枪外，不用再破第二次也能让你看见。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你把当年在楚院重走脱手那几步的方法再用一次，先在地上标自己最后还能退的脚位。标过才知，这回比枪脱手早了两招。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 第二次开始你肯多留一回枪，末场便真多走几步。可是要把势一口气全压出时，仍在同一处空了手。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你先照楚院的习惯并排记招数，写满一页仍说不出哪一步已没法退。第二晚只好另铺一张，改从脚位重记。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 一开始你输得更快：留路成了迟疑，老人从空处进。你只得再试，直到那条路仍能让你接人，而不是只供自己退远。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你递进的去处都留着自己回得来的脚位。楚院那条规矩，隔着三十年仍在替你省力。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 老人一退，你也重新认眼前的远近。原来能连出的几枪少了，你觉得别扭，手却终于不再总赶在自己脚前面。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 这一阵你几处抢入都没留退脚。薛的重棍一压，你才想起楚师早骂过这一手。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你重写两页，写到自己只顾枪尖的时候，脸仍热。阿原回信说拿到馆里试了，起先众人替你解释，走一遍才知道真走不过。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你的回信也照旧先写自己哪里没走通。两边都肯把没会的先摆出来，信才一直有得写。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 阿原试后写回来，另一边不照你预备的走，解法便又堵了。你只得再把当日被逼住的前半截补寄，白多走一程信路。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你回信仍先试完再寄。有一封迟了半月，就为等一个自己还没证出的解法。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你试了一次，发现他留给慢脚学生的那半步真有用。回信没抄自己新学的大枪，只把有一处仍会卡肩的地方问清。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 信里只问他哪晚方便，没有替全馆订日子。阿原回定下月一晚，叫你别赶头班，夜里这班脚慢，正好看仔细。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 这一夜练的是他的课。回楚师处以后，你才把停下的长枪接回，没把两个地方算成一日。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我往前走。不是把你这里忘了。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 楚师那句以后不要来了，你守着。每年托人带一封不问教的路信，他回得短，你都留着。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 不带一张几招几招的脸来，就给你茶。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 后来你又去看过楚师两回，坐坐便走，不带一张请教的脸。他骂你闲坐，茶照旧给你晾着。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你把一条路放开，去迫另一处真要抬棍的地方。棍仍重，你却不必每次都把自己的肩一并递上去。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你把放开一路逼他抬棍的走法也讲给楚师。他只问：放开的果真是路，还是让出来的方便？你答不出，当夜又在院里走了一遍。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 先前你总想补回胸前那两寸，这次肯多看棍尾落下以后的一步。枪不因此变轻，却终于不再只替他提供又一次正面相撞。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你把看棍尾再起的走法讲给楚师。他说看是会看了，肯等第二回吗。你说上回已在等，他说那就再看十年。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你让虎口松开，痛才一阵阵清楚起来。薛没因你肯收就把棍退半寸改成平，今天这一场仍是你败。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 虎口那道裂到雨里发胀，你没有为抢回一招再添新的。带回来的伤就一处，想的东西倒是很多。

firstDivergence.text: 你近枪要我还是双手重棍，我偏不替你拿着。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你劈惯了，却仍先剔出钉眼旁裂的一块，免得火里乱爆。老人叫放靠里，不夸北榜第四肯做小事，只问锅边还缺不缺。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 离枪时也有一日大雨。你想起初见时把湿柴剔开，先垫高明日要用的干柴，晚间仍有一锅热水。老人自己端走一盆，叫你也洗洗手上的灰。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你伸手想扶，他叫先别压那边。木椅还没接好，你这一帮反倒会把新口又扯开。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 离枪时也有一日大雨。你照旧先挪开椅边木屑，回头才见门边一捆柴已浸湿。晚间把能烧的挑出来，多熬半个时辰，才给两人烧够热水。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 敢问前辈姓名？

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 下山后你对阿原说起那日问名。他说难怪你回信绕着写——原来那晚你连对方是谁都没敢猜。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 三枪，我没走进去。敢问前辈？

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 当日你先认三枪没走进去才问的名。后来在山中每回被压下，都先认这一句，再谈下一枪。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 信写到六十一还不会，你停了一阵，终于没划掉。你也写明老师不叫改门，让问艺别先替你订满。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 后来那位晚辈早已敢在堂前说不会。教更年轻的人时，他先讲秦师六十一仍写信认重学，没把一生只会越来越强当作拜师前必须装的样子。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 曾传的伤退说法，后辈如今能讲清。他仍记得那半月额外的馆师和两日撤约，也记得你真回来说明，不拿被误会就从此不必开口作结。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 阿原说他换过两种握法，你先听完才试。少年又卡在旧处，这回你不急着报一个更高的字，让他慢走，自己看那只腕什么时候先拧。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 枪一搭，他仍能逼你挪脚。你把那一点接住再放开，不为第三次只百招便催对方早点停。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 第三场接完的那半步，此刻仍在你脚底。少的力没有散，今日这条枪是接得完的。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 他没替你留空，旧路也不再原样。你真接过才知道少了不等于把人放过去，枪在手里，下一步仍得走。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 他那句这回是少，不是散，你此刻才真验完：少了的力，接得住真来枪。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你再来。先看你自己的脚。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 他再进，脚也变了。你接住的是眼前这一枪，不是重复一个能给后人抄成开悟时刻的姿势。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你请他照样先进。接住的才是眼前这一刀，不是昨日院里那一瞬的重复。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 第八刀落在杆中，弯势传入掌。你顺它转杆，尾自另一侧扫来，韩只能退开。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 第八刀顺杆转的那一下，今日变半枪半棍时又用了一次：不与眼前的力比直，顺着它换自己的路。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 枪柄点地，长枪竖起，接住第八刀。你没替那一下弯求一个永远不动的稳，顺着转，枪尾逼得韩退。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 枪尾从侧面回的那一路，今日半枪半棍里又露了一回。韩家旧场教的，武当山上仍旧使得。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你请他看刚才左臂被点的地方，那里仍有血。他没因认输便改口说本来让你，指了你肩前还可早换的一线。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 韩指过的肩前那一线，今日在藤条下又露了一回。被人看过的地方，藏不住。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你们把刀与枪从停处再慢移一次，胸前一寸与肩外四寸并没因赢输便变成整整一层轻重。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 你想起韩收刀后仍肯指你差处。今日被藤条压着，你也把看见的说出口，不拿赢过门外的人当遮掩。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 百招后他向前，藤每进，你便退。你想从旧枪里换一条，才看见半数路都得先经过他已经站好的地方。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 百招后他往前，完整架子看似仍在，下一枪却总要从已被他占住的一处起。你退过一百一十二、一百二十、一百三十，终于知道不能再照样走。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 清和松藤，右手两指搭杆，旁带半寸。你忽觉整杆没有可发的力，左手两指已停喉前。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你看见他松手，已不算被旧动作骗住；可两指贴杆带半寸时，你的力仍落不到可续处。另手停喉前。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 二百七十后，你枪反比先前更整，连续逼他退五步。不是因马上要输就先乱给人看，今天你已走到比来时更深的地方。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你变过了，二百七十后更整，也逼他退五步。可一场里看见一次还不够，真正到毫厘时，身体仍会替你先作一个旧日最合理的准备。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你等的是该从那里出的剑。我偏晚一点。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 柳当年用细枝比的路，你还留着旁注。你叫年轻人坐旁边看，自己慢走换手；他指早了，你再走一遍，等他看准，不替他先报答案。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 那块旧扶手，是当年离旧观时老人扔给你，叫留着烧火的。你没烧，后来也一直没烧。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你离去时不知道这会是最后一面。多年后仍能记住茶与一句先练，没必要让自己当年多会一层预知。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你少去一场外地的邀约，旧枪仍留架上，拿来馆里现用的练枪。年轻人本以为听完三段传奇便能回去，你叫他先站到纸前，别破。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你少亲带一班，交给阿原，自己带年轻人去旧馆里坐。他想先摆总谱第十一的名，你叫收回，让对方先讲周老师当年怎样骂人。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你慢走，教习从旁托你的肘。脚补上，肘却抬高了，你看一眼他的手，又走一次。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 来掌不同，你得再让半步。原来第五掌少转那半分，也不是从此永远留给自己的空处。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 刀与棍回到同一处，手却不能用一样的拧法。你试得起劲，老人先把枪收起来，问今天还有没有别的事。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 我下次先送，再看。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你这回问得倒好。还有，今天借的灯，记得还。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 听不懂便直问，你连薛百川的剑也这么问。他说你问得笨，答得却比谁都全——笨问题省下的暗话，后来都变成了正招。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 她接完，问灯。你从怀里摸出灯油单，才想起灯还在另一院。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 所以很好。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 十二年的那一剑，你后来仍认。这一掌没处用旧应法时，你先想的不是自己丢脸，是那半掌里也许也压着谁没说出的年数。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你三日后回来，真有一事要你判门里学哪一路。

firstDivergence.text: 三人都愣，谢先问为何没回。你没答不想见他们，也不替谢藏锋补一个自己没问到的苦衷。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

firstDivergence.text: 他脚下仍有旧伤，铁杆借水上的短近，早不是硬摆回一张旧剑图。你接他慢递的一下，退开，才让徒弟照实记看见的兵器。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 榜上记的是谢无灯与那根铁杆，不是又像了一次师传。徒弟照实写下的兵器那一行，后来没有人需要再改。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 病人今日没少一位，你可别替我另挂一块要出去比剑的牌。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 严与杜那两句不想打，你也照记。榜外不是被忘，是他们自己选下的位置——这话后来果然不必收回。

firstDivergence.text: 你把原订远访托给同门，留新抄手自己问一回。门外有人要将三十招胜第八直接送上榜，你叫年轻人先把对方也找来，不替他问完才叫他抄。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 院里有人又问第二遍。你听见纸翻过一页，没有替他先答；那一行还肯慢下来，门便没有只剩一个写对过的人。

comparison.suffixPolicy: same first offered choice in each run

firstDivergence.text: 你托同门守当天的问事，自己到外县见不愿再赶来的人。新抄手想跟，你只带这一位，另班得由别人真教，不能说出门也算自己都教过了。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 远来的人在门边坐下，不必先有能打进榜的名字才配把话说完。你放下已交出的钥匙，听接班的人问他真看见哪一段。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 让抄手自己答第一句、你在旁接漏处——沈说的肯问第二遍，你把这个机会先给了年轻人。

choices.assessment: Observed text/state divergence only; literary significance requires the accompanying editorial review.

firstDivergence.text: 木剑一搭，你看出他会怎样回，不替从前没有在场的自己多记十招。抄手先记今天示范，另列原战十二见证，没把它们揉成同一场。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 示范与原战你在场也分开。沈说不懂武、不懂人都不够，你教抄手的头一条正是：今天看见的，不替当天写。

lastDifferentSceneBeat.text: 第十八这三年的胜负，是被人完整听过一遍才起的争辩。先听全再说话——院里今天多几个人学会了这一手。
